subject: Request: temporary rate makeup for prefetch gap — exec sign-off needed
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan@craftly.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: revops@craftly.com
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up — prefetch gap impact on Craftly launch (asking for temporary rate credit)

Alex —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Craftly's engineering team ran a quick perf pass and found a regression tied to the missing prefetch optimization for our large customer queries. The result is 2x token cost for the busiest path during our pilot window.

We committed to a public beta launch in August and this delta creates uncertainty in our go/no-go. Given the roadmap note that prefetch is targeted in Redwood's Q3 patch, we're requesting a temporary commercial uplift (rate makeup / credit) for the incremental cost from July 15 -> Aug 31 while the runtime change lands.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve a short-term credit (we estimate ~$12k) or point me to the right person to expedite? We need an answer for our exec brief tomorrow.

Attachments: craftly_latency_report_q3.pdf (summary)

— Susan
VP, Product — Craftly
From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: Susan Park <susan@craftly.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up — prefetch gap impact on Craftly launch (asking for temporary rate credit)

Hi Susan —

Really appreciate the context and the report. I reviewed the numbers with engineering; the prefetch optimization is scheduled in our upcoming runtime patch but the release is gated by an integration regression we're tracking.

Short answer: we want to support Craftly and avoid blocking your launch. I'll escalate for a temporary commercial accommodation. To move fast, can your team confirm the exact incremental spend for the pilot (line item by date)? That will help me scope a clean make-good that our revenue ops can sign off on.

Next steps I propose:
- Craftly to provide a 2-week spend breakout (your revops)
- I'll prepare a one-page commercial term (duration, cap, accounting) for exec sign-off
- If approved, I can commit to communicating an internal carveout by EOD Fri so you have visibility for your briefing

I've looped Marissa (sales lead on the account) and Karthik (head of product partnerships) to help with the commercial language and product timeline.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up — prefetch gap impact on Craftly launch (requesting exec sign-off)

Team — forwarding Craftly's note and the latency report. Quick summary and ask for the group:

Summary:
- Incremental cost visible on their pilot path due to lack of prefix prefetch; estimate provided but needs line-item detail
- Launch deadline: early August, needs commercial certainty this week for exec brief
- Proposed remedy: temporary rate makeup or a capped credit from Jul 15–Aug 31

Commercial ask (what I need from product/ops):
1) Product confirmation that prefetch patch is likely to ship in the next two weeks and that the fix will materially reduce token cost for their flow. If the ship is uncertain, we need a fallback window and a plan for rollback.
2) Ops: an approximate upper bound on customer-side incremental cost we should expect if no patch ships by Aug 1 (ballpark is fine).
3) Sales: I'll draft a 30–45 day term sheet for a capped credit but this needs an exec sign-off for any >$10k commitment.

If product can confirm a high probability of patching, we can offer a smaller credit with milestone-based reduction. If there's risk of delay, we should escalate to execs for a one-time accommodation.

Neha — can you run a quick check on precedent and whether finance needs an SOW amendment?

Marissa
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jul 2028 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up — prefetch gap impact on Craftly launch (requesting exec sign-off)

Marissa / Alex —

Quick product update and recommended path for exec: we validated the regression (root cause: missed KV cache warm path when sequences exceed 8k tokens in their schema). The engineering patch is done and passes CI in internal canaries; deployment is scheduled for the infra release window on Mon Jul 31 (US-west). That timeline is high confidence but not zero-risk — we still need the rollout window.

Recommendation:
- Approve a conditional, capped credit up to $12,000 for Jul 15–Aug 7. The credit terms: 100% of incremental spend above their baseline for that window, capped at $12k. If the patch lands on Jul 31 and metrics return to baseline by Aug 7, credit is prorated accordingly.
- Require Craftly to provide the two-week spend breakout by EOD Fri to finalize numbers.
- Ask execs to sign the one-page waiver approving the cap; I've drafted the language and attached a suggested term sheet (proposed-makegood-term-sheet.xlsx).

Neha: please confirm if finance requires a formal billing memo or if this can be handled as a one-time contractual credit recorded in billing adjustments. If we need exec signature, Alex/Marissa — can you route to Sales Ops + CFO approval?

Karthik
Head, Product Partnerships
